Tepové zóny z tepové rezervy (Karvonen):: Heart rate zones from heart rate reserve (Karvonen): we take the maximum heart rate from your profile if you enter it (measured in a test or race), otherwise we estimate it from your hardest runs and age — the zones are then labelled “estimate”. Resting heart rate comes from overnight measurements. Z4+ (≥ 80 % of reserve) = hard work — the intensity channel is counted from it. If you enter your threshold heart rate (LTHR) in the profile, the zones are based on it (Z4 from 95 % of threshold). Heart rate lags behind in short efforts, so we also count hard minutes from pace in running intervals (speed on the flat, converted uphill) and take the higher of the two. Hard minutes from cycling and swimming count towards intensity too, against their own maximum heart rate (on the bike usually 6–10 beats lower than when running, in swimming about 12).
